properties.summary: Illustrative massing from the plan set Cupertino approved in February 2024: each block's podium, the buildings above it and its towers, traced from the plans and extruded to the heights in the approved building sections: podiums of 27 to 43 ft, townhouses of 30 ft, residential buildings of 80 to 133 ft, residential towers of 166 and 200 ft and office towers of 186 to 228 ft. Each piece is drawn to its tallest point; real buildings step. Block 13 is an outline only: the 2026 modification cut the project's office space by exactly Block 13's amount, and its new plans aren't published. Nothing has been built yet.
properties.note: Drawn from the 2024 approved plans to each piece's tallest point; the 2026 changes aren't published.

controls.label: P-0800.01 existing property line vs Santa Clara County parcels 316-20-121/122: trimmed RMS over the closest 80% of 6292 points

approved_plans.title: The Rise SB 35 modification, Attachment A - Approved Plans (approved Feb 16, 2024)
approved_plans.pages: P-0101 (PDF p. 2): block uses; P-0800.01/.05/.06 (pp. 78, 82, 83): footprints; P-0800.24 (p. 84): block numbers; P-0831/P-0832 (pp. 89-90): heights

approval_letter.pages: p. 1: approves the plan set in Attachment A; p. 13: no height limits apply

third_modification.finding: Recital 4: up to 1,474,946 sq ft of office (2024 plans: 1,954,613, of which Block 13 479,667). The Feb 27, 2026 plans are not published.

block_5.finding: Block 5 apartments: 234 affordable units with Eden Housing.
